# Design Handoff: Calendar Events
**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent) on behalf of Agno JF

## Result

The local design is ready for implementation. It reuses the existing application stack, authentication middleware, Inertia page structure, shadcn/ui components, and administrative activity logging.

## Traceability

| Requirement | Design coverage |
|---|---|
| RQ-14 (The application should provide a calendar with scheduled events) | `CalendarEvent`, `CalendarController`, `AdminCalendarEventController`, `calendar.tsx`, and `calendar-view.tsx`, including administrator edit/delete actions and continuous multi-day markers |
| RQ-08 (The application must work on desktop, tablet, and mobile devices) | Responsive month grid, mobile schedule list, responsive event form, and local frontend checks |
| RQ-10 (Protected routes, APIs, and files must enforce server-side access controls) | Active-user middleware on viewing and admin middleware on event creation, editing, and deletion; focused authorization test |
| RQ-11 (The application must support HTTPS, backups, restore testing, monitoring, and administrative activity logging before launch) | Local creation activity logging is implemented; staging operational evidence remains open |

## Open Limits

The target environment and release operations remain blocked by Gate 1 evidence. The configured local timezone is `UTC`; a different organization timezone requires configuration direction before participant use.
